name: protein phosphatase 6 catalytic subunit

function.text: PPP6C encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 6 catalytic subunit [Cleaved into: Serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 6 catalytic subunit, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. It participates in protein dephosphorylation and COPII vesicle coat assembly.
